name: Mono
author: RusTV
description: Pure black OLED theme with a white accent, flat tiles and a thin focus ring.
details: True black background (OLED friendly), white accent and no glow. Tiles are flat with small corners, and the focused tile is marked by a thin white ring only. Only colors and tile styling change.
